questions.question_text: A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. Write down the mathematical name for this quadrilateral.
AB is a straight line. Find the value of x.
A bag contains 2 blue balls, 3 red balls and 5 green balls only. One ball is chosen at random. Find the probability that this ball is red.
Write down a prime number between 60 and 70.
Write 36 as a product of prime factors.
Point A has co-ordinates (2, 12). Point B has co-ordinates (4, 2). Find the co-ordinates of the midpoint of AB.
Use the cumulative frequency curve to estimate the inter-quartile range.
Here are the first four terms of a sequence. 13, 9, 5, 1. Write down the next term.
Here are the first four terms of a sequence. 13, 9, 5, 1. Find an expression, in terms of n, for the nth term.
Shade the given sets in each of these diagrams (A' intersect B and (A' union B)').
Point A has co-ordinates (2, 3). Point B has co-ordinates (4, 11). Find the equation of the line AB. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.

A factory makes soft centre chocolates and hard centre chocolates only. The probability that a chocolate chosen at random has a hard centre is 0.6. Three chocolates are chosen at random. Find the probability they are all soft centre chocolates.
Write as a single fraction in its simplest form. (n + 1)/(n - 1) - (n - 1)/(n + 1)
